title: The African Business 1984 Index provides a comprehensive overview of various economic and political developments across African nations during that year. It covers topics such as oil drilling, food strategies, exports, and budget discussions, highlighting significant events in countries like Mozambique, Nigeria, and Zambia. The index also addresses challenges such as joblessness, financial legacies, and international aid, while showcasing initiatives in sectors like solar power, transportation, and agriculture. Overall, it reflects the dynamic landscape of African business and governance in 1984.
